# Integration Boundary preparation result

Status: **candidate local meaning, carrier request and six source-bound records; no Lab admission or tested interface**.

The [Definition source](../../model/definitions.json) now distinguishes `ea.integration-boundary` from a component, option review, verification contract, owner Decision and release binding. A boundary is the stable producer/consumer seam and behavioral obligation that remains when its vendor or library changes. Its individual project-scoped Definition/v1 record, ontology node and review/binding relations are generated candidates.

The [six boundary records](../../model/integration/boundary-index.json) cover browser capture, resumable transfer, private media custody, speech to text, background blur and assistance safeguards. Each names responsibility, producer and consumer, inputs and outputs, data classification and purpose, interface, capability, invariants, failure/recovery route, source documents and links to its option review, technical verification contract and candidate Lab Challenge Contract. Option reviews, verification contracts, component references and challenge triggers now use stable `IB-01` through `IB-06` identities.

The [Integration Boundary Artifact Type Request](../../model/carriers/integration-boundary/v1/request.json) compares Lab Schema/v1, Contract/v1 and Implementation/v1 with this distinct validation purpose. Its [closed candidate schema](../../model/carriers/integration-boundary/v1/schema.json) and source-bound records do not claim Lab Artifact Type/v3 conformance. The [gap register](../../model/carriers/gaps.json) leaves exact interface signatures, data schemas, owner principals and quantitative tolerances open before conformance runs.

Current [carrier coverage](../../model/carriers/coverage.json): 151 selected Lab carrier candidate records, 160 local candidate records, 19 Artifact Type Requests and 16 explicit gaps. [Validation](../../tools/validate_boundary_records.py) checks source parity and review/verification/challenge link closure, while selected Lab schema and workspace checks remain structural. The [fresh exact Lab review cut](../../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/proposals/engineer-assessment-research/2026-10-26/integration-boundaries-v1/manifest.json) pins this proposal for owner inspection; it confers no selected implementation or active data flow.
